notes.title: CAMPS EDITION! [DLCs]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/d41c08f99ab94f397bffe00df1cf8472e4ed2022.jpg[/img]


[h1]In Cruz Brothers, all DLCs from year one are included in the game’s full price.[/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/a86ee280383b2477458c2f255ba8337e3d624d3c.png[/img]

Our most important Upgrades will be referred as “Training Camps“, each with it’s own theme and purpose. Some CAMPS will update the game’s functionality, others the mechanics. Of course, there will be CAMPS that will add a whole new extra content!

Below you can learn more about the first six Training Camps being officially announced.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/0a1d01e7a80da57b013478d7740c53f84e0c9fc0.png[/img]
[h1]COMBAT SCHOOL CAMP 1[/h1]

[b]AVAILABLE NOW[/b]

Improvements in the Fight System Mechanics.

Super Moves have smaller impact on the Damage outcome.

Defense moves, such as Dodge, are more effective.

It became way harder to break your blocking stance.

Balanced: DAMAGES from normals and specials.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/82f72b334ec662dcad849f1c5963fa9d462a79a1.png[/img]
[h1]CONNECTIVITY CAMP[/h1]
The Connectivity Camp is the On-line Gameplay implementation.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/06385673239e32df51c3183ba4a7946666c2c760.png[/img]
[h1]COMBAT SCHOOL CAMP 2[/h1]
Improvements and changes in the Fight System Mechanics.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/6ad15dc444245e00ff2f4e782c9c0b65fcf00484.png[/img]
[h1]ROOKIE CAMP 1[/h1]
A whole new Team of fighters with a new playable Stage.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/c16993780b09a52455360546fa4a07240428ee58.png[/img]
[h1]COMBAT SCHOOL CAMP 3[/h1]
The last improvements and changes for year one for the Fight System Mechanics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/24d7c0c9c72ba43770a6a27af365799aa07eae04.png[/img]
[h1]FLASHY CAMP[/h1]
The release of a massive package of customizable items.

 

Please note: the CAMPS are not going to be released, necessarily in that exact order.

notes.title: Training Camp 1 Released! [DLCs all included]
notes.content:
Are you ready for some adrenaline-pumping boxing action? A tale of blood, sweat and tears is ready to unfold before you – Cruz Brothers, the dramatic fast-paced hand-drawn boxing Game is releasing its first Updates. And there are much more coming! 

[h1]In Cruz Brothers, all DLCs from year one are included in the game's full price. [/h1]


Our most important Upgrades will be referred as "Training Camps", each with it's own theme and purpose, when updating the game's functionality and/or mechanics. And of course, there will be those Camps that will add a whole extra content!

Below you can check the first two Training Camps to be announced.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/24a5f708b2bffeefd2983e06f9fe94ef87f921e3.png[/img]
[i]''Combat School is the work developed by the trainer, where he approaches all possible combat situations. Improving the fighter's performance and result''.[/i]
[b]Marcus Luz[/b]

[h1]In ''Combat School Camp 1'' the fight became even more competitive.[/h1]
- Super Moves have smaller impact on the Damage outcome. 
- Defense moves are more effective, such as Dodge.
- Now it is way harder to break your blocking stance.
- Balanced: DAMAGES from normals and specials. 

[h1]Go to Sparring and surprise yourself with the new changes![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30483727/38eb9cc9f92042d7426c18297b4b425c0dc60545.png[/img]
We all know that fighting brings people closer together. It is the oldest tradition in human history. No matter what country you're from, we're all human beings and fighting is in our DNA.

[b]We get it! We like it![/b]

Soon you will be able to share this experience with your friends from around the world!

[h1]THE ONLINE GAMEPLAY IS COMING![/h1]

notes.title: CRUZ BROTHERS DLCs - All Included
notes.content:
[b]Hello fighters from around the world! Welcome to the Cruz Brothers![/b]

We at DCF Studios are happy to know you decided to engage in this tale of blood, sweat and tears, that is ready to unfold before you! And we couldn't leave it behind, a very important Topic: the DLCs or Updates.


[h1]All DLCs will be included in the game's full price![/h1]


And yes there are many coming! We will use this post, to update you on all the DLCs.

Right away we can official publish de following: 

[h1]On-line Gameplay[/h1]
The on-line feature is being developed right now, as we discuss this topic! And its is soon coming!

[h1]Trainning Center Customization[/h1]
Soon you will be able to fully customize your Trainning Center. Yes, the very first scene from the game, the main menu. This will influence your fighter's attributes while playing on-line. We will post more about this DLC further this year.

[h1]Clothing Pack[/h1]
All characters will gain more itens as the updates goes.

[h1]New Teams/Charactes/Stages[/h1]
We cannot yet confirm, what characters that are coming. But be aware, they are! And already trainning hard to soon get you. So be sharp and ready when they arrive!


Have fun!
